trial_title: Fludarabine and Cyclophosphamide With or Without Rituximab in Patients With Previously Untreated Chronic B-Cell Lymphocytic Leukemia
brief_summary: This randomized phase III trial is studying fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, and rituximab to see how well they work compared to fludarabine and cyclophosphamide in treating patients with B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

eligibility_table.criterion: Diagnosed B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) defined by the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Working Group criteria
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a confirmed diagnosis of CLL as per the provided conditions.

eligibility_table.criterion: Binet stage C disease
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Binet stage C classification based on the presence of anemia, thrombocytopenia, or the involvement of three or more lymphoid areas?

eligibility_table.criterion: Binet stage B disease AND ≥ 1 of the following signs or symptoms
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has Binet stage B disease, indicated by bulky lymphadenopathy.

eligibility_table.criterion: B symptoms (night sweats, weight loss ≥ 10% within the previous 6 months, fevers > 38°C or 100.4°F for ≥ 2 weeks without evidence of infection), or constitutional symptoms (fatigue)
eligibility_table.justification: No specific information on B symptoms or constitutional symptoms is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced night sweats, weight loss of ≥10% within the previous 6 months, or fevers >38°C for ≥2 weeks without evidence of infection?

eligibility_table.criterion: Continuous progression (doubling of peripheral lymphocyte count within the past 6 months and absolute lymphocyte count > 50 G/I)
eligibility_table.justification: No evidence of continuous progression is provided; lymphocyte counts are not specified.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a doubling of the peripheral lymphocyte count within the past 6 months, with an absolute lymphocyte count exceeding 50 G/I?

eligibility_table.criterion: Evidence of progressive marrow failure as manifested by the development/worsening of anemia and/or thrombocytopenia
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values indicating anemia or thrombocytopenia are provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a decrease in hemoglobin levels to <10 g/dL or a platelet count <100,000/µL since the initiation of treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Massive, progressive or painful splenomegaly or hypersplenism
eligibility_table.justification: No information on splenomegaly or hypersplenism is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a spleen size greater than 20 cm or experience symptoms of hypersplenism such as pain or significant cytopenias?

eligibility_table.criterion: Massive lymph nodes or lymph node clusters (> 10 cm in longest diameter), danger of organ complications through large lymphoma (e.g., vascular compression or tracheal narrowing), or progressive lymphadenopathy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has bulky lymphadenopathy, which suggests progressive lymphadenopathy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Occurrence of symptomatic hyperviscosity problems at leukocyte counts > 200 G/I (symptomatic leukostasis)
eligibility_table.justification: No information on hyperviscosity problems or leukocyte counts is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any symptoms of hyperviscosity at leukocyte counts exceeding 200 G/I?

eligibility_table.criterion: No Binet stage A disease
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Binet stage classification of B or C?

eligibility_table.criterion: No transformation to an aggressive B-cell malignancy (e.g., diffuse large cell lymphoma, Richter's syndrome, or prolymphocytic leukemia)
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any transformation to an aggressive B-cell malignancy, such as diffuse large cell lymphoma or Richter's syndrome, since the initiation of treatment?

eligibility_table.criterion: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-1
eligibility_table.justification: Patient ECOG score not recorded
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1?

eligibility_table.criterion: Cumulative Illness Rating Scale (CIRS) score > 6
eligibility_table.justification: No CIRS score is provided; thus, it cannot be assessed.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Cumulative Illness Rating Scale (CIRS) score greater than 6?

eligibility_table.criterion: Life expectancy > 6 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's excellent performance status suggests a life expectancy greater than 6 months.

eligibility_table.justification: Bilirubin levels are not provided, so it is unclear if they meet the criterion.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's total bilirubin level ≤ 2 times the upper limit of normal (ULN)?

eligibility_table.justification: Alkaline phosphatase and transaminases levels are not provided, making it impossible to assess.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Are the patient's alkaline phosphatase and transaminase levels ≤ 2 times the upper limit of normal (ULN)?

eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
